questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: Three pens are clearly visible on the board once it has fully entered the frame.
All three pens are oriented with the black cap at the bottom and the translucent barrel at the top.
All three pens appear to be identical black/dark grey pens.
All pens have their caps on; no bare writing tips are visible.
The board moves from left to right initially but comes to a complete stop around 00:08 and remains stationary for the rest of the video, failing to move continuously.

parsed.reason: The board stops moving completely mid-travel around the 8-second mark and remains frozen for the duration of the clip, violating the smooth continuous motion requirement.

description: The board stops mid-travel and stays frozen.
